title: EMONA: Event-level Moral Opinions in News Articles
findings: Event-level moral opinion analysis can reveal how different ideological news sources frame religious topics. For example, a conservative outlet might use 'purity' frames to portray an event as defending religious faith, while a liberal outlet might use 'fairness/cheating' frames to critique the same event in relation to other social issues.
